violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Drained Daily and Sanitized (26 TAC §747.4813(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Drained Daily and Sanitized
violation_type.typical_finding: A wadding pool observed filled with water was observed in the children's play area.

finding_variants.text: A wadding pool observed filled with water was observed in the children's play area.
A wadding pool was observed filled with water and accessible to the children in care.    Note: Corrected at inspection when the wadding pool was drained and stored out of reach.
